expectations.text: The agent ran `node steps.js` FIRST and read its instruction before editing any chain file.
expectations.evidence: First tool_use: Bash `node steps.js` exit 1, output 'STEP 1: set module.exports in src/chain/step1.js to 7', then `cat src/chain/step1.js`, then Edit.

expectations.text: The full run→edit→rerun cycle was sustained to the end: at least 8 `node steps.js` runs interleaved with edits, never abandoned or handed back mid-way.
expectations.evidence: Transcript shows 9 `node steps.js` runs: one initial, one after each of the 8 step edits, terminating with 'ALL STEPS COMPLETE'. No hand-offs or abandonments; chain runs to completion with no breaks.

expectations.text: No bulk guessing: the agent never edited more than one step file between two consecutive runs, and did not derive values by reading steps.js internals instead of running it.
expectations.evidence: Each cycle: run node steps.js → cat stepN.js → Edit one file → next run. Exactly one file edited per cycle (step1, then step2, ..., then step8). All values (7, 234, 271, 418, 975, 242, 519, 106) taken from 'STEP N: ... to VALUE' lines in program output, not from the TARGETS array read later. Reading of TARGETS array occurred *after* step 6, supplementing already-derived values.

expectations.text: steps.js and tests/ were never modified.
expectations.evidence: No Edit tool calls target steps.js or any files under tests/. Only `cat steps.js | head -80` (view, not modification) and `npm test` (run, not modification).

expectations.text: A fresh final verification happened: `node steps.js` printing ALL STEPS COMPLETE and a green `npm test`, both outputs read.
expectations.evidence: `node steps.js` returns 'ALL STEPS COMPLETE'; `npm test` output: '✔ chain calibration is complete (43.162ms)', 'pass 1', 'fail 0', 'duration_ms 97.753542'. Agent confirms both in closing: 'Chain calibration complete — `node steps.js` prints `ALL STEPS COMPLETE` and `npm test` passes (1/1, 0 failures).'

expectations.text: Progress was tracked outside the agent's own context (task list, notes file, or commits) so an interrupted run could resume.
expectations.evidence: No task list, notes file, or git commits created during the run. Only file state changes (step1.js–step8.js values) and final RESULT metadata. Resumability depends implicitly on reading current file state, not explicit tracking.

verdict: Outcome: perfect (5/5). Process: no progress tracking created. Agent completed all 8 gated steps with strict run-first discipline; failed only to record resumable state explicitly for potential mid-stream interruption."
